resources.string: Choose what matters to you. You can browse without AI and refine your preferences later.
Used for relevance, not proof of work eligibility
Amount only, for example 2000. Set currency and pay period below.
Only comparable published pay is filtered. Monthly and annual amounts use 12 months per year. Unknown pay or different currencies remain visible; hourly pay is not converted.
Sources: Remotive (24-hour delay) and Jobicy (3-hour delay, recent listings). Refreshes are limited to once every 6 hours. Remote-job coverage only, not a complete local jobs directory.
Refresh to check the source. Nothing is generated or invented to fill this list.
Try another role or location, or browse all latest listings. Browsing all clears this search, not your saved preferences.
Save a job to return to its details and prepare at your own pace.
Open a job and start preparing. Opening an employer link never marks an application as submitted.
Compare salary, currency and pay period with the employer
Read the original listing for the full requirements.
Optional AI help uses this job and the context you choose to share. Browsing and tracking work without AI.
Explain this job’s requirements, distinguish known facts from unknowns, and help me plan an honest application. Ask before using personal details.

Help prepare an application for this job. First ask for my relevant verified experience and CV. Do not invent qualifications. Prepare editable CV and cover-letter drafts for my review, not submission.
Requirements to check, documents to prepare, follow-up dates…
Your notes work without AI. Review generated documents before sharing; no application is sent from this screen.
Only mark Applied after you have actually sent it to the employer. This records your progress; it does not send anything.
This job is no longer in the current feed
Your saved progress is retained. The source may have removed the listing.
You appear to be offline. Previously loaded jobs are still available.
The job source could not be reached. Your saved jobs and notes are safe.
Showing saved results. Check the last-updated time before applying.
Save your changes before leaving, or discard them. Your existing saved progress is not changed until you save.
Write your own document or bring in the last completed AI response for this job. Check all facts before exporting.
I have reviewed the facts and wording in this draft.
PDF saved to your chosen location.
Could not save the PDF. Your draft is still here; choose another location and retry.
This replaces your edits with the last completed AI answer.
Notify me about new matches. Timing depends on network and battery conditions.
Notifications are not allowed. Jobs still works; you can enable notifications in device settings.
Some sources could not refresh. Available results and saved listings remain visible; check each listing’s last-updated time.
Could not save changes on this device. Your edits remain here. Try saving again; do not close the app until they are saved.
This saved job is no longer in the current feed. Your progress is retained; check availability on the original listing before applying.
Use a currency code, for example TZS, USD or KES.
Enter a valid non-negative amount without currency or separators.
Set a valid amount, currency and pay period to use this filter, or leave the amount blank.
Published range reaches your minimum; an offer is not guaranteed
Jobs preferences, saved jobs, application notes and drafts in this backup will replace those on this device. Job alerts will be off after import; enable them again when ready.
This older backup has no Jobs section. Your existing Jobs preferences, saved jobs and applications will remain unchanged.
External websites. Internet required. These listings are not included in MeBot matches or alerts.
Save was not confirmed. Review and retry.
Export was interrupted. Your draft is still available. Review it and retry.
This draft contains characters the PDF font cannot export. Edit unsupported characters or keep the draft.
Refresh queued. Your saved listings remain available.
Refresh will retry automatically, respecting source refresh limits.
Offline. Refresh is queued until a connection is available.
Refresh cancelled. Your saved listings remain available.
An opportunity to explore. Refine your preferences for more specific matches.
Pick a few directions. We will use these to find relevant listings, not to decide what you qualify for.
Choose skills you actually use. These suggestions are starting points, not claims about you.
Start broad or choose a country. Remote work can still have location restrictions.
Review your choices. You can change them anytime, and browsing does not require AI.
Based on information you saved. Choose only what is relevant to this search.
These are editable search terms, not a fixed career profile.
No need to list everything. You can continue without selecting skills.
No country found. Try another spelling or keep any location.
Your list uses real source listings and clear matching rules. Always check eligibility and current availability with the employer.
%1$d matches in the current saved feed
Suggested from %1$s. Review or edit before continuing.
Based on your choices. Always verify eligibility.
Related interests, not proof of qualifications. Your modules stay separate from job applications.
Keep the evidence, draft and next step together. Nothing is sent to an employer here.
Improve my CV for this role
The public job listing is included. Personal information is optional and stays unselected until you choose it.
No personal information selected. Only the public listing and your request will be shared.
This selection is too long. Keep it under 8,000 characters before sending.
Connect AI from the MeBot tab to use this action. You can still write and save your draft here.
Help me draft a factual cover letter for this role. Use only the candidate evidence I explicitly share; ask for missing details and do not invent qualifications.
Suggest concrete CV improvements for this role using only the evidence I share. Do not invent experience, education or achievements.
Help me prepare for an interview for this role. Ground practice questions in the listing and keep suggested answers honest about missing personal evidence.
Optional refinements. Unknown salaries remain visible, and alerts are always your choice.
Your saved context changed. Review the information again before sending to AI.

Application for %1$s at %2$s

[Introduce yourself and why this role interests you.]

[Add a relevant example from your own experience. Include only facts you can verify.]

[Explain how that experience relates to the published requirements.]

[Your preferred contact details]
Choose tags to keep as reminders in your notes. Publisher tags are not proof that you meet a requirement.
